title: Signs fixed by a coordinate restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\rho$ assign to each of the $n$ coordinates one of three statuses: free, fixed to $+1$, or fixed to $-1$. On the coordinates that are not free, define the fixed sign assignment to be $+1$ where $\rho$ fixes the coordinate to $+1$, and $-1$ everywhere else.
